shortDescription: Shuts down a specific VxRail Host

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: dryrun
options.description: Perform an optional dry run to check whether it is safe to shut down the host. The default value is false.

options.name: evacuate_poweredoff_vms
options.description: Choose whether powered off vms should be evacuated off of the chosen host before shutdown. The default value is true.

options.name: host_sn
options.description: The serial number for the host to shut down

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for cancelling the host shutdown, the default value is 60 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
